## Artifact field types

{{< include /guide/inventory/_field-types.qmd >}}

## View, search, and filter artifacts fields

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa gear >}} Settings**.

2. Under {{< fa expand >}} Artifacts,  select **Artifact Fields**.

    Displayed in groups[^2] as lists are the artifacts fields available to artifacts in your organization with a quick view of:[^3]

    - Number of workflows that field is used in[^4]
    - The field key
    - The field type[^5]
    - Field description
    - Whether or not the field is required when creating artifacts
    - Quick actions you can take on the artifact field

    The **Default Fields** group is always listed first. It shows the fields {{< var vm.product >}} provides on every artifact, such as **Status**, **Severity**, and **Proposed Remediation Plan**. For each default field:

    - **Artifact Types** lists the active artifact types the field is turned on for.[^9]
    - **Required** lists the artifact types that require the field when creating an artifact.

    **Title** and **Description** apply to all artifact types and are always required. You can configure the other default fields for each artifact type,[^10] but default fields can't be renamed or deleted.

3. Narrow down existing artifacts fields available to your artifacts by searching or filtering for results:

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Search fields

a. Click **{{< fa magnifying-glass >}} Search** to search by keywords within an artifacts field.

b. Select whether to search in the **Title** or **Description**.

c. Click **Search** to narrow down your results by your entered keywords.

    Expand any inventory field group to see more fields.

#### Filter fields

a. Click **{{< fa filter >}} Filter** to filter fields by any of the following criteria:

    - **Artifact Types** — The types of artifacts that use this field. In the Default Fields group, this shows the fields turned on for the selected types.
    - **Required On Creation** — Whether or not the field was set up as required on artifact creation.
    - **Types** — What type of field it is.
    - **Workflow Triggered By Field** — What workflows are initiated when this field is edited.[^6]
    - **Write Permissions** — Which inventory record stakeholder types have permissions to edit this field.[^7]

b. Click **Apply Filters** to narrow down your results by your configured criteria.

    Expand any inventory field group to see more fields.
:::

::: {.callout title="Note that searching and filtering of fields stack."}
For example, if you first search by keyword for `Regression` under **Title** without clearing that search, any additional filters applied will only apply to the results returned by that initial search.
:::

## Configure default artifact fields

For each default field except **Title** and **Description**, choose which artifact types use it and how it behaves when artifacts are created:

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa gear >}} Settings**.

2. Under {{< fa expand >}} Artifacts,  select **Artifact Fields**.

3. In the **Default Fields** group, hover over the field you want to configure.

4. When the **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** menu appears under the Actions column, click on it and select **{{< fa sliders >}} Configure**.

5. For each active artifact type, set:

    Enabled
    : The field appears on artifacts of this type: on the artifact details page, in artifact filters, and in workflow steps. Turning a field off also turns off the two options below.

    Show on creation
    : The field appears when creating an artifact of this type. When off, the field can still be filled in on the artifact details page after the artifact is created.

    Require on creation
    : An artifact of this type can't be created without a value for the field, whether in the {{< var validmind.platform >}} or through the {{< var vm.product >}} API.

6. Click **Save Configuration** to apply your changes.

    If you turn a field off for an artifact type that a workflow uses the field on, the workflows affected are listed first. Click **Yes, Disable** followed by the field name to save anyway.

::: {.callout title="Some default fields have fixed rules."}
- **Risk Area** is always required when it is shown on creation.
- **Status**, **Attachments**, and **Proposed Remediation Plan** can only be turned on or off. New artifacts start in the default status, and attachments and remediation plans are added on the artifact details page after creation.
- Turning a field off hides it but keeps the values already saved on existing artifacts. Those values remain available through the {{< var vm.product >}} API and data exports.

:::

## Add or edit artifact fields
<span id="add-edit"></span>

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa gear >}} Settings**.

2. Under {{< fa expand >}} Artifacts,  select **Artifact Fields**.

    Here you can edit existing artifact fields, or add a new one:

{{< include /guide/validation/_add-edit-artifact-fields.qmd >}}

### Rename artifact field keys

To rename the field keys for artifact fields:

{{< include /guide/inventory/_rename-field-keys.qmd >}}

## Add artifact field groups

To group artifact fields, first create an artifact field group:

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa gear >}} Settings**.

2. Under {{< fa expand >}} Artifacts,  select **Artifact Fields**.

3. Click **{{< fa plus >}} Add Group** and enter a **Name** and a **Description** for the group.

4. Click **Create Group** to add the new group.

5. Assign the desired fields to the group.[^8]

## Delete artifact fields

::: {.callout-important title="Artifact field deletion is permanent."}
Deleting an artifact field will remove it from all artifacts using that field, even if the field has been populated on an artifact.
:::

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa gear >}} Settings**.

2. Under {{< fa expand >}} Artifacts,  select **Artifact Fields**.

3. Hover over the field you would like to delete.

4. When the **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** menu appears under the Actions column, click on it and select [**{{< fa trash-can >}} Delete Field**]{.red}.

5. Click **Yes, Delete Field** to confirm permanent deletion.
